label: Freezer Control
info:
Controls multiple freezers via MQTT-switched power outlets. Each freezer's
internal thermostat is set to its minimum (~-25 degC), so the outlet is the
effective thermostat. The flow duty-cycles the outlets to minimise cost while
respecting a per-device hard temperature ceiling.

Optimisation inputs:
  - live PV (global.ess.pac, shared with battery controller)
  - current price and 24h forecast (global.pp.price24, ct/kWh -> EUR/kWh)
  - learned thermal model per freezer (cooling_rate, warming_rate, running_power)

Reused configs (same ids as appliance and battery controller flows):
  MQTT broker     mqtt_broker_config (192.168.4.221)
  InfluxDB infra  influxdb_config_infra (temperature sensor history)
  InfluxDB tmp    influxdb_config (power sensor history)

Device wiring:
  og_gefrierschrank  temp  sensor/status/temperature/og_speis/ht/4   payload.value degC
                     pwr   tm/tele/OgSpGfr/SENSOR                     ENERGY.Power W
                     cmd   tm/cmnd/OgSpGfr/POWER                      ON|OFF
  kg_kuehltruhe      temp  sensor/status/temperature/kg_garage/ht/1   payload.value degC
                     pwr   hm/status/HM-ES-PMSw1-Pl NEQ1809653:2/POWER
                     cmd   hm/set/HM-ES-PMSw1-Pl NEQ1809653:1/STATE   true|false

User API (MQTT):
  home/freezer/<name>/override  payload: ON | OFF | AUTO (retained)
  home/freezer/<name>/status    retained JSON status snapshot

State is kept in global.freezers[<name>] so other flows (monitoring, UI) can
read it. The thermal model is recomputed hourly by joining InfluxDB
`infra.temperature` (field value, tag Device) with `tmp.power` (field val,
tag device) over the last 7 days. No `freezer` measurement is used.

=== In-flow decide tests ===
info:
Click any test inject button to run a scenario through fc_decide with a
fixed `now`, mocked freezer state, prices, PV and thermal model. Results
appear in the debug sidebar (filter for topic `test/...`). The decider
skips all global state and MQTT side effects when msg._test is set.
